question: Of the football clubs listed below, which is the oldest in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Calcutta FC**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Calcutta FC** is the oldest football club in India, established in 1872.
 
• It is one of the first football clubs formed in Asia.
 
• Calcutta FC has a rich history and has contributed significantly to the development of football in India.
 
• The club is based in Kolkata, a city known for its passionate football culture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **FC Kochin** was established in 1997 and was one of the first professional football clubs in India.
 
• **Madras FC** and **Bombay FC** are also notable football clubs but were established later compared to Calcutta FC.
 
• Kolkata, formerly known as Calcutta, is often referred to as the "Mecca of Indian Football" due to its historical significance in the sport.
